rules.title: MD5 Hash Function
rules.description: MD5 is cryptographically broken. Collisions can be generated in seconds on modern hardware.
rules.cex_impact: If used for transaction hash verification or password storage, attacker can forge identical hashes.
rules.recommendation: Replace with SHA-256 or SHA-3. For passwords, use bcrypt/argon2/scrypt.

rules.title: DES Cipher
rules.description: DES uses a 56-bit key which is completely broken and can be cracked in hours.
rules.cex_impact: Plaintext can be recovered by an attacker, leading to data exposure.

rules.title: AES-ECB Mode
rules.description: AES-ECB mode leaks plaintext patterns.
rules.cex_impact: Attackers can observe repetitive structures in encrypted data.

rules.title: Hardcoded Cryptographic Keys
rules.description: Hardcoded keys expose systems to anyone with access to the source code.
rules.cex_impact: Attackers can decrypt traffic, forge JWTs, or steal user funds.
rules.recommendation: Use an HSM or key management system (AWS KMS, HashiCorp Vault).

rules.title: Non-Cryptographic PRNG
rules.description: Using insecure random number generators for security functions.
rules.cex_impact: Attackers can predict tokens, passwords, or keys.
rules.recommendation: Use secrets.token_bytes or os.urandom in Python, crypto.randomBytes in JS.

rules.title: JWT Algorithm None
rules.description: JWT alg=none allows an attacker to bypass signature validation.
rules.cex_impact: Full account takeover and authentication bypass.

rules.title: JWT Signature Verification Disabled
rules.description: JWT signature verification is disabled.
rules.cex_impact: Attackers can forge arbitrary JWTs.
rules.recommendation: Set verify=True and enforce signature checking.

rules.title: TLS Verification Disabled
rules.description: TLS certificate verification is disabled.
rules.cex_impact: Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attacks.

rules.title: Hardcoded Wallet Seed Phrase
rules.description: Wallet seed phrase (mnemonic) is hardcoded.
rules.cex_impact: Immediate theft of all crypto assets associated with the wallet.
rules.recommendation: Store seeds in HSM or secure enclave.

rules.title: Hardcoded Ethereum Private Key
rules.description: Ethereum private key is hardcoded.
rules.cex_impact: Immediate theft of all funds.

rules.title: Hardcoded Bitcoin WIF Private Key
rules.description: Bitcoin private key is hardcoded.
rules.cex_impact: Immediate theft of all funds.

rules.title: PBKDF2 Insufficient Iterations
rules.description: PBKDF2 uses insufficient iterations.
rules.cex_impact: Passwords or keys can be cracked via brute-force easily.
rules.recommendation: Increase iterations to industry standards (e.g., >600,000 for PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256).

rules.title: Deprecated TLS Version
rules.description: Deprecated TLS versions like TLSv1.0 or SSLv3 are in use.
rules.cex_impact: Vulnerable to known attacks like POODLE or BEAST.

rules.title: RC4 Cipher
rules.description: RC4 is a broken stream cipher.
rules.cex_impact: Plaintext can be recovered.

rules.title: Short JWT Secret
rules.description: JWT secret is too short.
rules.cex_impact: Signatures can be forged by brute-forcing the secret.
rules.recommendation: Use long, random secrets (at least 256 bits).

rules.title: RSA Without OAEP
rules.description: RSA encryption without OAEP padding.
rules.cex_impact: Vulnerable to padding oracle attacks.

rules.title: Reused IV/Nonce
rules.description: Initialization Vector or Nonce is reused.
rules.cex_impact: Breaks confidentiality of stream ciphers or GCM.
rules.recommendation: Generate a unique IV/nonce for every encryption operation.

rules.title: Missing Salt in KDF
rules.description: Key Derivation Function lacks a salt.
rules.cex_impact: Vulnerable to precomputation attacks (rainbow tables).
rules.recommendation: Always use a strong, unique salt.

rules.title: SHA-1 Usage Detected
rules.description: SHA-1 is vulnerable to collision attacks.
rules.cex_impact: Digital signatures can be forged.

rules.title: Node.js TLS rejectUnauthorized: false
rules.description: Disabling TLS certificate checking in Node.js.
rules.cex_impact: MitM attack.
